remaining_scientific_and_engineering_lim.detail: Only the verified released BPP-LIBERO checkpoint is evaluated after this adaptation. The source checkpoint uses single-arm LIBERO sensorimotor/camera/action semantics; the experiment does not represent every BPP checkpoint or its original benchmark capability.

Source twoRGB streams, EEF/gripper proprioception and single-arm OSC action10 are changed to one current ZEDRGB, measured qpos18 and absolute dual-arm action16; demonstrator proprioception/actions are removed from the prompt. Approximately99.9905percent parameter-shape transfer does not certify preservation of modality/token/motor meaning or lossless dual-arm adaptation.

Each group uses50unique human clips reused across four levels. All50Seen clips are in the correspondingCk training prompt pool; all50Scratch/P+FT clips are in the target training prompt pool. Zero-shot clips are outsideCk training pools by the held-out task mapping. Seen/P+FT are not clip-disjoint or actor-disjoint human demonstration tests.

One training seed/initseed1 per lineage and ten reset seeds100000..100009 per fixed task-level. Shared clips/tasks/resets and shared Scratch induce dependence;2000rollouts are not2000independent training replicates. No significance or population-level reliability claim is made.

Official task/split/horizon/controller endpoint and human-video interface align at the declared benchmark level. Initialization, trainable capacity (~347M), anchor-vs-episode sampling, fixed16-frame prompts, preprocessing, action/state normalization, loss masks/objectives and action/replan representation differ from Zero-WAM and other baselines.45k/90k/135k update counts and8x8globalbatch do not establish matched samples, epochs or FLOPs; no strict paper ranking is claimed.

Frozen single-view CLIPCLS caching, fixed224resize without original randomcrop/colorjitter and95percent evalcentercrop, source-specific image orientation, and recorded1280x720vs native224square camera projection remain disclosed adaptation differences. Existing source review found no audited arm-order/unit/absolute-delta mismatch, but no new calibration, source-LIBERO positive control or expert replay was performed.

P+FT installs target-only state quantiles/actionminmax after loadingCkEMA; no affine compensation of projection/output weights is applied. This creates a legitimate learned coordinate change during target3000updates, shared target statistics with Scratch, with no isolated effect measured.

Healthy optimization, nonzeroSR and normal process exits establish admissible system measurements, not proof that all remaining adaptations are lossless, human prompts are causally used, or any individual mechanism caused successes/failures.
